name: Vampire Necromancer

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Unholy Strength
traits.details: Any undead ally in the aura deals 5 extra necrotic damage.

traits.name: Burned by Sunlight
traits.details: Whenever the vampire starts its turn in direct sunlight, it takes 5 radiant damage.

traits.name: Grave Healing
traits.details: If the vampire takes an extended rest in or on its grave dirt, it regains all of its hit points. It cannot rest while in bat form or mist form.

auras.name: Unholy Strength
auras.details: Any undead ally in the aura deals 5 extra necrotic damage.

effect.description: The vampire can use claw twice, or it can use claw once and allow one undead ally within 5 squares of it to make a basic attack as a free action.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: one dazed, dominated, stunned, or unconscious creature

hit.description: damage, and the vampire regains hit points equal to the damage dealt.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: one creature that can see the vampire

hit.description: The target is dominated (save ends), or the target can choose to take 2d8 + 6 psychic damage instead.

effect.description: The vampire can alter its physical form to appear as a Tiny bat or a cloud of mist. In either form, it gains a fly speed of 10 and can immediately shift up to its fly speed. In bat form, the vampire retains its bite and beguile powers, but cannot use claw or undead master. In mist form, it becomes insubstantial and cannot attack. It can retake its normal form as a minor action.
